description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/SearchProduct/getListingsImages. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Returns the first image of active listings for concrete publication ids. ownerAgent: listings. Domain: listings. Entity: exact_listing. Operation: get_exact. Scope: current_store. Use when: Use it only when concrete listingIds are already known and thumbnails are needed for those exact listings. Input: Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId and body int[] with concrete listingIds. Does not accept free search or store scans. Output: Returns a map from published product id to image URLs. Search terms: searchproduct getlistingsimages. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
